Description
Tube with 25 x  1 oz silver Britannia coins are the perfect investment for anyone looking to buy a Great Britain Britannia coins. This batch 1 oz Great Britain Coins each weigh 1 troy ounce and contain .999 silver bullion coin minted by the
Royal Mint
. The total of 25 pieces equals 25 troy oz in weight and .999 purity create an attractive purchase with over 25 ounce’s of pure silver content, making this one of the best coins on the market for its price point!
The observation has the left-profile portrait of King Charles III or Queen Elizabeth II masterfully designed by Martin Jennings. The design adheres to the tradition of featuring the male monarch without a crown and reversing the orientation of the monarch’s portrait.
The reverse has the portrait of the famous Britannia, holding a shield and trident, representing Britain’s power and influence. The details on the design add security layers to the coin to prevent it from being counterfeit. The wave pattern, smooth lines of the shield, a hologram that transform into a trident, and the micro-engraved “Decus Et Tutamen” on the inner rim, all account for its security features
Main Highlights of Great Britain 1 oz Silver Britannia Coins BU Random Years Tube of 25
Contains 25 troy oz of .999 fine silver.
The Royal Mint Production
Multiples of 25 coins are packed in tubes. Multiples of 500 coins are packed in “Monster Boxes”. All other coins will come in protective packaging or capsules.
Observe: Portrait of His Majesty King Charles III or Queen Elizabeth II encircled by “CHARLES III or ELIZABETH II DG REX FD or DG RFG F D, and 2 POUNDS” carving.
Reserve: Featured the renowned Britannia standing over a rock, holding a shield in her left hand, and stretching her right arm wide, holding a trident, symbolizing strength and integrity. It has the carving of “BRITANNIA”, “YYYY”, “1 oz”, “999 FINE SILVER”.
Includes advanced security features
